purpose: Resolve original FY2018 and FY2019 inventory/revenue tag and period semantics from submitted XBRL, before diagnosing FY2019 pair discontinuity.
checks: Hash exact original EX-101.INS bytes and preserve accession identity.
Require undimensioned CIK 0001045810 USD inventory instant and each allowed revenue tag for the exact original fiscal year duration.
Record normalized original fact values to distinguish equal-value alias from true value conflict; do not select an alias by coverage or returns.
decision_rule: Only diagnose the frozen-source pair rule from original same-accession facts. A repair or new information test requires a separate frozen decision; these XML reads alone do not make historical PIT or factor input qualified.
